export.title: Export to Anki
export.notice: Downloads a text file with your review cards, one per line, for Anki's File > Import. Columns: Hanzi, Pinyin (with tone marks), Meaning, Example, Source, Tags (HSK level and origin).
export.empty: No cards to export yet. Add some to your review deck first.
export.error: Could not build the export file.

import.title: Import from Anki
import.notice: Choose a text file exported from Anki or from this app. You will see a preview before anything is added. Cards whose Hanzi you already have are skipped.
import.preview: The file has {total} cards: {new} new and {existing} already in your deck.
import.skipped: {count} lines had no Hanzi and were skipped.

error.none: No cards found in that file.
error.apply: The import failed. Your deck was not changed.

help.title: New to Anki?
help.step1: Anki is a free flashcard program that uses spaced repetition: it shows each card again just before you would forget it. On Android use AnkiDroid (free); on iPhone Anki is paid.
help.step2: Download the file above. In Anki open File > Import, pick the downloaded file and set the field separator to Tab. Anki then shows the columns: Hanzi, Pinyin, Meaning, Example, Source and Tags.
help.step3: Map Hanzi to the front of the card and Pinyin and Meaning to the back. Tick "Allow HTML in fields" if you see stray symbols, then press Import.
help.step4: Your progress does NOT sync between Anki and this app. Answers you give in Anki do not change the schedule here, and answers here do not change Anki.
